newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes slightly up in low trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes slightly up in low trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Thursday closed slightly up in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 595.76 from 594.91 on Wednesday.
Trade volume was 312,163 dinars against 2.57 million dinars.
Lease company Tunisie Leasing was down 1.24 dinar to 46.44 dinars. Investment fund eased 1.14 dinar to 37 dinars.
AMEN bank won 0.54 dinar to 56.1 dinars. ($=0.97 dinar)
